title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Boone Gorges…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Boone Gorges BuddyPress Docs plugin versions up to and including 2.2.7. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
